selected_evidence.requirement: Keep application data under `/srv/data` on snapshot-capable storage
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the LVM PV/VG/LV, XFS filesystem mounted at `/srv/data`, application files, and persistent systemd/fstab configuration.

selected_evidence.requirement: Capture an earlier filesystem snapshot and demonstrate later modification
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the filesystem-consistent `prechange` snapshot, baseline hashes, divergent modified hashes, and the additional post-snapshot file.

selected_evidence.requirement: Restore the exact content captured by the earlier snapshot
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the snapshot merge reaching 100%, LV reactivation/remount, matching per-file and whole-tree hashes, restored original content, and removal of post-snapshot data.

selected_evidence.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.

Captures healthy pre-restart data with boot ID df8bab0d-5c09-47a2-a150-4ce12d0f9549, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID a5f00a13-77f6-4315-a515-16f0ea1797f8, recovered services and mount, and byte-identical application data after reboot.

cat > /usr/local/sbin/activate-srv-data-storage <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
BACKING=/var/lib/srv-data-storage/lvm-pv.img
LOOP=/dev/loop0
if ! losetup -j "$BACKING" | grep -q '^'; then
    if losetup "$LOOP" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        printf '%s is already in use by another backing file\n' "$LOOP" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    losetup "$LOOP" "$BACKING"
fi
pvscan --cache "$LOOP" >/dev/null
vgchange -ay srvdatavg >/dev/null
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/activate-srv-data-storage
cat > /usr/local/sbin/deactivate-srv-data-storage <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
BACKING=/var/lib/srv-data-storage/lvm-pv.img
vgchange -an srvdatavg >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
LOOP=$(losetup -j "$BACKING" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
[ -z "$LOOP" ] || losetup -d "$LOOP"
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/deactivate-srv-data-storage
